item.title: BMI announces first tenant for former Prince Albert Pulp Mill site
item.description: The former Prince Albert Pulp Mill site has its first tenant. item.title: Student-inspired mural unveiled at water treatment plant
item.description: A mural inspired by artwork created by Prince Albert students was unveiled Friday at the City’s water treatment plant, highlighting clean water and environmental stewardship. The mural stretches across a series of wooden panels and features detailed etched imagery connected by a flowing river. item.title: City preparing housing strategy as Prince Albert faces affordable housing shortage
item.description: Prince Albert officials are developing a housing strategy aimed at addressing a significant shortage of affordable housing in the city.
